# External reference material

These are preserved external documents, not New Yokosuka implementation notes
or independently verified project findings. Keep our interpretation in
[research](../../research/README.md), with links to the relevant source.

| Material | Provenance and scope |
| --- | --- |
| [Original source examples](original-source-examples.md) | Preserved wiki text about C source left on game discs; retains its TCRF/Ehm credit and its own provenance header. |
| [Shenmue I map IDs](shenmue1-map-ids.md) / [Shenmue II map IDs](shenmue2-map-ids.md) | Imported wiki-format map tables. |
| [Shenmue I memory addresses](shenmue1-memory-addresses.md) / [Shenmue II memory addresses](shenmue2-memory-addresses.md) | Imported wiki-format memory tables; addresses are version/context dependent. |
| [Shenmue I function addresses](shenmue1-function-addresses.md) / [Shenmue II function addresses](shenmue2-function-addresses.md) | Imported wiki-format function tables. |
| [MAPINFO](mapinfo.md) | Imported wiki-format map-container description. |
| [Scene script instructions](scene-script-instructions.md) | Imported wiki-format stack, registers, and instruction reference. |

The repository's existing research cites the Wulinshu wiki for scene-script
documentation. Exact original URLs, revisions, and individual authors were not
recorded consistently for these older table imports; their wiki syntax alone
does not establish that provenance. Do not invent missing attribution or treat
these imports as a freshly verified copy of a current web page.

Their original text is preserved. Moving it here does not relicense the quoted
material or original game code under the project's license. For future imports,
record the exact source URL, title, author/credit where available, revision or
retrieval date, applicable license, and any local edits.
